technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term bullish structure with price above key moving averages and supertrend support, but intermediate momentum is conflicted with overbought stochastics, bearish MACD, and no fresh entry signals—suitable for continuation trades only, not new swing entries.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 29 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 17) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no conviction from senior members; neutral overall signal with asymmetric risk-reward favoring long positions in panic conditions.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.28), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 29 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (price above major MAs, supertrend bullish, EMA 50/200 cross) combined with extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) creates asymmetric risk-reward for contrarian entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate momentum is broken (overbought stoch 85.5 with no cross, bearish MACD, no entry triggers), fundamental conviction is absent (zero insider activity, low retail interest), and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, strong USD) with earnings binary risk in 29 days make this a continuation-only setup, not a new swing entry.
